uz: Mitsubishi M701JAC gaz turbinasi ~1600°C harorat sinfida ishlaydi va combined cycle rejimida FIK (samaradorlik) 64% dan oshadi.
en: The Mitsubishi M701JAC gas turbine runs at a ~1600°C temperature class and exceeds 64% efficiency in combined-cycle mode.

uz: Bug' turbinasidagi lopatkalar (blades) sekundiga 500+ metr tezlikda uchi bilan aylanadi — bu tovush tezligidan tezroq.
en: Steam turbine blade tips can move at over 500 m/s — faster than the speed of sound.

uz: HRSG (Heat Recovery Steam Generator) gaz turbinasining ~600°C chiqindi gazidan bug' hosil qilib, umumiy FIKni ~30% ga oshiradi.
en: An HRSG captures the gas turbine's ~600°C exhaust to raise steam, boosting overall plant efficiency by around 30%.

uz: Generatorlar vodorod (H₂) bilan sovutiladi, chunki vodorodning issiqlik o'tkazuvchanligi havodan ~7 barobar yuqori.
en: Generators are hydrogen-cooled because H₂ conducts heat about 7 times better than air.

uz: Bir yirik gaz turbinasi kompressori havoni siqishga o'z quvvatining deyarli yarmini sarflaydi.
en: A large gas turbine's compressor consumes nearly half of the turbine's own power output just to compress air.

uz: Turbina rotori ideal balansda bo'lishi shart: 1 gramm nomutanosiblik 3000 ayl/min tezlikda kuchli vibratsiya beradi.
en: A turbine rotor must be perfectly balanced — even 1 gram of imbalance causes strong vibration at 3000 rpm.

uz: Combined Cycle Power Plant (CCPP) bitta yoqilg'idan ikki marta energiya oladi: avval gaz, keyin bug' turbinasi orqali.
en: A Combined Cycle Power Plant extracts energy twice from one fuel: first via the gas turbine, then the steam turbine.

uz: Bug' turbinasi lopatkalari monokristall (single-crystal) qotishmalardan quyiladi — butun lopatka bitta metall kristali.
en: High-temperature turbine blades are cast as single crystals — the entire blade is one metal crystal.

uz: Sovutish suvidagi kislorod metallni yemiradi, shuning uchun deaerator suvdan erigan gazlarni chiqarib tashlaydi.
en: Dissolved oxygen in feedwater corrodes metal, so a deaerator strips gases out before the water enters the boiler.

uz: 1,6 GW quvvatli elektr stansiya taxminan 1 million uyni bir vaqtda ta'minlay oladi.
en: A 1.6 GW power plant can supply roughly one million homes at once.

uz: Turbina moyi tizimi (lube oil) faqat moylash emas, podshipniklarni sovutish uchun ham xizmat qiladi.
en: A turbine's lube oil system doesn't just lubricate — it also cools the bearings.

uz: Gaz turbinasi soniyasiga bir necha yuz kilogramm havo yutadi — bu katta reaktiv dvigatelga o'xshaydi.
en: A gas turbine ingests several hundred kilograms of air per second — like a giant jet engine.
